profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft with deep expertise in Windows networking, spanning kernel drivers, virtual switching (vmswitch/VFP), and container networking on Kubernetes. Over the years, I have worked across core networking components—including protocol drivers and firewall systems—and later specialized in SDN data plane technologies such as virtual switch and virtual filtering platform. I have led complex debugging and root cause investigations for critical production issues, improving system reliability and security across Windows and Azure environments.  Currently, I focus on container networking and validation for AKS and ACI, leading the development of a test lab environment for end-to-end testing. This platform enables early regression detection and scalable validation across networking components, helping ensure production readiness of Windows container scenarios.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Driving reliability, security, and scalability in the Windows networking stack, with deep expertise in Virtual Switch and Virtual Filtering Platform. I specialize in solving complex, large-scale production issues across Software-Defined Networking and container platforms (AKS/ACI), driving root cause analysis, security fixes, and reliability improvements.

I lead cross-team initiatives to elevate engineering quality—building scalable validation systems, influencing design decisions, and aligning partners across Windows and Azure. Passionate about mentoring engineers and driving a culture of technical excellence, I focus on delivering secure, resilient, and high-impact platform solutions that power modern cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Drove the delivery of high‑quality Windows releases by leading deep investigations into complex production issues across Software‑Defined Networking scenarios (virtual switch and virtual filtering platform). Specialized in root cause analysis of security, reliability, and performance problems, partnering closely with product teams to design and implement robust fixes.
Expanded impact beyond individual contributions by introducing structured debugging approaches, strengthening test coverage, and improving backporting strategies to reduce regression risk. Played a key role in accelerating resolution timelines and improving release quality. Actively fostered collaboration and knowledge sharing through code reviews, technical discussions, and mentorship, contributing to a stronger engineering culture and more resilient networking platform.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and delivered high‑quality Windows service releases across core networking components, driving improvements in reliability and debugging efficiency. Specialized in low‑level root cause analysis using WinDbg/WinDbgX, ETW tracing, Xperf/WPA, memory dump analysis, and custom debug extensions to investigate security issues, collaboration requests, and production issues. Built automation tools (e.g., crash dump analyzers) to reduce investigation time and improve signal clarity. Diagnosed complex kernel‑level issues across TCPIP, NDIS, VMSwitch, and IPSec, contributing to timely, high‑quality fixes. Proactively shared knowledge through training, documentation, and mentorship, strengthening team capability and debugging depth.
positions.insights: Networking Internals, Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
positions.description: Developed high-performance USB/SCSI kernel drivers for enterprise-grade scanning systems, enabling reliable high-speed image data transfer at the hardware interface layer. I also built advanced digital image processing libraries to enhance post-processing efficiency and output quality. To ensure seamless ecosystem integration, I implemented industry-standard TWAIN and ISIS drivers, enabling compatibility with leading imaging platforms such as Adobe Photoshop and Microsoft Office. Additionally, I exposed robust Win32 and COM-based APIs, empowering developers to build scalable, high-performance imaging applications. My work improved system stability, accelerated data throughput, and strengthened developer productivity across diverse imaging workflows.
positions.insights: Digital Image Processing, Kernel Device Drivers and +3 skills

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed automation solutions for Air Handling Unit (AHU) systems using SolidWorks 2000 and Visual Studio (VB/VC++), improving engineering efficiency and design accuracy. As a certified SolidWorks Support Engineer and API Trainer, delivered technical training to enterprise customers including Samsung, Hyundai Heavy Industries, and Century, enabling teams to effectively leverage CAD automation. Built custom SolidWorks add-ons such as FanWorks and ToolWorks to streamline complex design workflows, reduce manual effort, and accelerate production timelines. Recognized for bridging engineering and software development, driving practical innovations that enhanced product quality, designer productivity, and scalable automation across diverse industrial applications.
